title: Re-Conditioning Cut After a Gap Between Program Days
content:
# Re-conditioning cut

**Rule.** For the hour-billed programs of the Workers' Compensation Referral (Work Conditioning Program and Work Hardening Program), the re-conditioning cut follows the calendar days since the worker's latest program day already recorded on the referral (or since the initial evaluation where none is recorded): two (2) hours where eight (8) or more days have passed, one (1) hour where four (4) to seven days have passed, and none otherwise.

The initial evaluation is the date of service of the referral's evaluation charge. The gap is counted from the date of service of the latest program day already recorded on the referral, before the day now being recorded.

## Decision table

| Calendar days since the latest recorded program day | Re-conditioning cut |
|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | none |
| 4 to 7 | 1 hour |
| 8 or more | 2 hours |

## Edges

- 3 days: no cut. 4 days: 1 hour.
- 7 days: 1 hour. 8 days: 2 hours.

## Cases (hypothetical)

- The latest program day recorded on the referral was a Monday, and the worker attends again on Wednesday of the same week: 2 days, no cut.
- The latest recorded program day was a Thursday, and the worker attends the following Tuesday: 5 days, a cut of 1 hour.
- No program day has yet been recorded on the referral, and the initial evaluation was 9 days before: a cut of 2 hours.
